descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸菜单，留着最后才吃的胡萝卜位置。
descriptions.en: My own paper menu marks the carrot saved for the last mouthful.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的小菜单上，洋葱与米饭之间留着一条弯弯的线。
descriptions.en: On my handmade menu, a curved line runs between the onions and rice.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我用一张纸折出两个朝向，记着灯塔旁那次没对齐的站位。
descriptions.en: I folded two directions into a paper card after our mismatched turns by the lighthouse.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使剪的小脚纸签，下沿故意空了一点，像还没落地。
descriptions.en: I left space beneath this paper foot so it still appears to hover.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的双折纸卡，一边一把小勺，合起来刚好安静。
descriptions.en: My two-fold paper card has a spoon on each side; closing it quiets them both.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我将两个折角朝向同一条自画横线，纪念一次终于站好的眺望。
descriptions.en: Two folded corners face the same line I drew, recalling the view we finally shared.
